push.title: L 4-5 vs UK Chargers | You: 8.4 (top 25% MID)
push.body:
Hoo-wee, BellyTb1. An 8.4. You played like someone who ate their vegetables.

DID WELL
+ A brace against UK Chargers. Goals are like biscuits: always better shared, but I'll take this one.
+ 0.6 better than your average. You're trending like a cat video.
+ 3 shots on target was worth +0.1 on its own. That's the quiet stuff that wins.
+ 5 goals conceded bought you +0.1. Sprinkles on the sundae.
+ top 25% of midfielders, league-wide. Not bad for a weeknight.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
- 62% passing (13 of 21, down from your usual 75%). Between you and me: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
- Passes attempted: 21. Respectable. Top-quarter midfielders get to 25+, and you've got it in you.
- Key passes: 0. Solid ground. The best midfielders push it to 2+.
- Fell to UK Chargers, 4-5. Tomorrow's a clean slate and we've got chalk.

Practice this: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.

That's the stuff. Same time next match? - Coach Lasso
